entities.summary: José Manuel Lara Bosch, 2nd Marquess of Pedroso de Lara was a Spanish media executive and businessman. He was the CEO of Grupo Planeta since 2003 and Atresmedia since 2012. Bosch was born in Barcelona, Spain.
